<summary>Original protocol design and initial 6e1 source-admission record</summary>

## Purpose and behavior

The original sequential full-stage scale study exceeded its registered deadline at 100k. Its failed run and partial coverage remain failed/incomplete. This PR adds a separately registered study of fresh mutation profiles for P8-006, using the original benchmark's pristine A/B, complete canonical comparison, phase attribution and over-budget closure requirements.

Each worker creates its own fresh A/B pair, performs both initial full builds and initial 15-table parity, applies exactly one registered mutation, runs the original incremental/resume closure, then completes full-control rebuild and final 15-table parity. Fresh batch profiles retain the target0 configuration witness; the config mutation alone expects target1.

The population is exactly **8 mutation profiles × 5 original scales × N30 = 1200 cells**, plus **5 actual N+1-file fanouts × N30 = 150 cells**. Fanout is not multiplied by corpus scales. Main dirty/resume settings remain 200/1024, fanout 8/128, and each worker's five-hour deadline includes all setup, indexing and comparisons. Failed or truncated prefixes provide no sample credit.

The optional profile scope is absent from old plans. Original full/cold validators and studies retain their identities and requirements. The independent driver binds every one of the 1350 slots to a single source, executable, build receipt, driver closure, run and attempt; all original raw reports, canonical tables, real counts and environment/resource observations are retained.

## Explicit workload and scheduling difference

This is a new fresh-history population, **not equivalent re-sharding of the old sequential study**. Its total worker-time allowance is 6750 hours versus the old750, although each worker retains its original five-hour limit. There are nine serial150-job matrices, each with max-parallel10; only one matrix is active at a time. The complete workflow has about1352 jobs and up to2702 artifacts, requiring complete pagination and bounded intake.

A planning calculation from already recorded historical components accounts for roughly254–264 worker-hours even before three missing100k batch cases, new fanout initial comparisons and orchestration overhead. Ideal division by10 is already25–26 hours for that partial set. Fresh/cache history differs, so this is not a reliable new-source ETA or speed guarantee. Plan this as multi-day work. Worker RSS records are snapshots, not measured peaks.

The actual study is **not started by this Draft PR**. Its distinct `p8-profile-run` label or explicit dispatch is a separate action after ordinary regression review. No profile label has been added.

## Fixed source and review

The fixed review base is `base/p8-cold-10ec-a217-20261009` / `10ec828beb94200ec679302c45115760ebd55ee9`. It includes the independently reviewed cold protocol and its formatter repair. Main's later crash-ready fix and other performance candidates require an explicit combined source review before integration.
